achievements.description: Run 1 successful office-based business
achievements.summary: Operate 1 successful office-based business.

steps.text: Rent an office building and establish a @mechanic{law firm}.
Recruit a lawyer and give the new employee a desk assignment at the firm. Open the law firm for customers.

achievements.description: Run 1 successful retail business
achievements.summary: Operate 1 successful retail business.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{gift shop} in a rented retail building. Install a cabinet with a cash register, shopping baskets and a rounded shelf.
Stock the shelf with cheap gifts and the register with paper bags. Open the shop and staff the register yourself or schedule a customer service employee.

achievements.description: Own a car worth at least $15,000
achievements.summary: Have a car valued at $15,000 or more.

steps.text: Choose a car with a value of @item{$15,000} or more and purchase the car from a dealership. @loc{Manhattan Luxury Cars} sells the Ferdinand 112 used for the highest tier.

achievements.summary: Have an apartment measuring at least 90 square meters.

steps.text: Check apartment floor areas on the map property cards, then sign a lease for a unit measuring @loc{90 square meters} or more.

steps.text: Check apartment floor areas on the map property cards, then sign a lease for a unit measuring @loc{500 square meters} or more.

achievements.summary: Have at least $100,000 of furniture in one apartment.

steps.text: Order furniture from @loc{Lux Concept} and install at least @item{$100,000} worth in the same apartment. Buy @item{P&S Peolab 90s} to add expensive furniture quickly.

achievements.description: Reach a weekly income of $10,000 for one business

steps.text: Grow one business until its weekly income reaches @item{$10,000}. Check @mechanic{Rivals}, select yourself, and inspect that business.

achievements.description: Reach level 50% of any employee skill
achievements.summary: Raise one employee skill to 50%.

steps.text: In @mechanic{MyEmployees}, unassign an employee and select @mechanic{Train Skill}, then @mechanic{Confirm}. Continue training until one skill reaches @mechanic{50%}; reassign the employee afterward.

achievements.description: Stockpile at least 100,000 of any product
achievements.summary: Keep at least 100,000 units of one product in stock.

steps.text: Rent warehouses, install @item{pallet shelves}, and import the same product until stored stock reaches @item{100,000 units}. Use @item{Paper Bags} for this stockpile.

achievements.description: Celebrate your 70th birthday
achievements.summary: Live through your 70th birthday.

guide.context: Age-reduction injections lower your displayed age without resetting the lifetime birthday counter.

steps.text: Make a separate save before fast-forwarding through old age. Keep that save so you can reload if your character dies.
During the wait, visit @npc{Mr Termity} in the left-most hospital office and take age-reduction injections when your character is eligible.
Let time pass until you reach your 70th birthday.

achievements.description: Win a total of $50,000 at the casino
achievements.summary: Accumulate $50,000 in casino winnings.

guide.context: Each casino visit credits the night’s net gain after gambling losses when you leave the boat. You cannot save aboard; reload your pre-boarding save if losses drain your stake.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Pier 5} on Friday after 18:00. Save before buying the $5,000 Casino Boat Ticket.
Play slots, blackjack or roulette, then leave the casino boat to credit the visit’s net winnings. Accumulate $50,000 across casino visits.

achievements.description: Produce at least 10,000 items in a factory
achievements.summary: Produce a factory total of 10,000 items.

steps.text: Rent or buy a warehouse and register a Factory business. Buy an assembly machine and pallet shelves from @loc{Factory Supply Depot}, 2 25th Street, Industry City.
Select a workstation type and recipe on the assembly machine. Attach the machines shown under Required production machines; green connection markers identify compatible positions.
Stock the listed ingredients on shelves. Hire factory workers and assign their machine shifts through @mechanic{BizMan > Schedule}.
Keep ingredients supplied and move finished goods out so storage stays available. Set production limits through @mechanic{BizMan > Factory} high enough to produce 10,000 items.

steps.text: Buy a home in @loc{the Hamptons} to access @loc{Halcyon Fairway}.
